criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Payment Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to issues with payments, including pending payments, overcharging, fees, and disputes.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Queries related to security concerns, unauthorized transactions, and card theft.

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Queries related to managing cards, including activation, PIN management, card delivery, and lost/stolen cards.

categories.name: Transfer Problems
categories.definition: Queries related to issues with transfers, including delays, failures, reversals, and cancellations.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Queries related to managing account details, personal information, and account deletion.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries related to currency exchange, exchange rates, and fees for exchanging currencies.

categories.name: Refunds and Reversals
categories.definition: Queries related to refunds, reversals, and discrepancies in transactions.

categories.name: Top-Up Assistance
categories.definition: Queries related to top-up issues, including pending top-ups, reversion of funds, and top-up verification.

categories.name: Card Types and Features
categories.definition: Queries related to different types of cards, virtual cards, disposable cards, and card features like contactless payments.

categories.name: App and Account Access
categories.definition: Queries related to accessing the app, verifying identity, resetting passcodes, and changing account information.

categories.name: Customer Service Satisfaction
categories.definition: Queries related to customer satisfaction, account deletion, and general dissatisfaction with the service.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to ATM transactions, issues with withdrawals, fees, and incorrect amounts dispensed.

categories.name: International Use
categories.definition: Queries related to using cards internationally, currency conversion, and fees for international transactions.

categories.name: Card Activation
categories.definition: Queries related to activating new cards, reactivating lost cards, and tracking card deliveries.

categories.name: Fee Inquiries
categories.definition: Queries related to fees for various transactions, including transfers, payments, and top-ups.

categories.name: Verification Process
categories.definition: Queries related to verifying identity, source of funds, and top-up verification.

categories.name: Transaction Delays
categories.definition: Queries related to delays in transactions, pending transfers, and missing funds.

categories.name: Card Network Preferences
categories.definition: Queries related to card network preferences, like Mastercard, Visa, and Apple Pay compatibility.

categories.name: Age Restrictions
categories.definition: Queries related to age restrictions for account opening and card usage.

categories.name: Exchange Rate Discrepancies
categories.definition: Queries related to discrepancies in exchange rates, incorrect charges, and exchange rate calculations.

categories.name: Direct Debit Issues
categories.definition: Queries related to direct debit payments, incorrect listings, and unauthorized direct debits.

categories.name: Rewards Program Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries related to rewards programs, fees, and benefits for frequent users.
